Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money of the limit, expressed in an eligible currency.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if a limit is a debit limit or a credit limit.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the limit, such as enabled or disabled.

StartDateTime.name: Start Date Time
StartDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the limit becomes effective.

UsedAmount.name: Used Amount
UsedAmount.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as an amount.

UsedAmountCreditDebitIndicator.name: Used Amount Credit Debit Indicator
UsedAmountCreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if the used amount of the limit is a debit amount or a credit amount.

UsedPercentage.name: Used Percentage
UsedPercentage.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as a percentage.

RemainingAmount.name: Remaining Amount
RemainingAmount.definition: Actual usage of the limit expressed as an amount.
